item.title: CyberPulse Daily — Access Without Asking (2026-10-05)
item.dc:creator: Tushar Vartak
item.description: Pre-auth paths into admin control, a file-write zero-day in an email security layer, helpdesk double zero-days used for intrusion, agentic automation attempting SQL injection against public sites, and a browser-side campaign that turns users into code runners — reduce unauthenticated reach to control, shorten authority, and monitor automation abuse.
